verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers real-time sync, reactivity, schema, auth, self-hosting, vector search, and MCP/CLI tooling, but contains no mention of offline support, local persistence, or conflict-free sync-on-reconnect for clients. Convex's documented model is 'real-time sync so your users instantly see the latest data' (convex-docs-21), which implies a live-connection paradigm rather than offline-first local writes; no doc or community source claims offline-capable clients.
